event.name: UConn Huskies at South Carolina Gamecocks

headlines.description: — During the final sweet moments of UConn’s 12th national title, Geno Auriemma and Paige Bueckers embraced after the star guard departed her final game with the Huskies.
headlines.shortLinkText: UConn returns to top of women's basketball, dominates South Carolina 82-59 to capture its 12th title
